info.name: Public Slite api Ask Search Notes API

params.name: query
params.description: Query used to perform the note search, default to empty string

params.name: parentNoteId
params.description: Optional filter to only return notes under this parent note id

params.name: depth
params.description: Optional filter to only return notes with a depth (number of parents) equal to a specified value

params.name: reviewState
params.description:
Optional filter to return notes in a special review state
Can be Verified, Outdated, VerificationRequested or VerificationExpired

params.name: page
params.description: Used to perform pagination on search

params.name: hitsPerPage
params.description: Specify how many notes to return per page

params.name: highlightPreTag
params.description: Inject a tag before the matching query

params.name: highlightPostTag
params.description: Inject a tag after the matching query

params.name: lastEditedAfter
params.description: Optional filter to only return notes edited after a specific date

params.name: lastUpdatedAfter
params.description: Optional filter to only return notes where metadata has changed after a specific date

params.name: includeArchived
params.description: Optional filter to also include archived notes in the search results (default to false)

items.docs:
Search notes based on a query.
The scope of the notes is restricted to the authenticated user.
Various optional filters are available to restrict the scope of the search even more.
